title: Pursuit Cycle — lose sight, pause, recon, tense, smell, continue. looking for fresh water.

the_cycle.1_sight: we had them. nestgate Oct 23: IN=736 JP=528. primals library full.
the_cycle.2_lose: Oct 24 nestgate: JP=0 IN=0 FR=3. the gate went empty. we lost the heading.
the_cycle.3_pause: do not invent a third country. do not call the empty gate 'gone forever'. stop the story. stand still.
the_cycle.4_recon: check EVERY spring we can legally drink from. CF zones. crates.io (OUR crates). GitHub public counts. Zenodo stats. space weather. not just the two wells we already sat at.
the_cycle.5_tense: the field is quiet. Kp=2 G0. X-ray class B. no quakes. a quiet magnetosphere is good hunting — tracks last. nothing is washing the scent.
the_cycle.6_smell: what actually moved. what is stale. what is fresh.
the_cycle.7_continue: follow the fresh spring. leave the stale water. come back to the cycle when we lose them again.

github_hud.smell: DRY. they did not star us.

zenodo_sporeprint.smell: DRY. DOI minted yesterday. nobody drank.

zenodo_barracuda.smell: FRESH. ten people took the zip. this is a spring.

crates_primal_barracuda.smell: FRESH. published the morning of the explosion. all 18 downloads are recent.

stale_water_we_were_drinking.confession: we cited squirrel-rng 14,207 and barraCuda 1,540 as OURS. recon says they are not.
stale_water_we_were_drinking.why_this_matters: we were smelling someone else's river and calling it our well. the pursuit failed because we followed the wrong water.

fresh_water.definition: a spring that moved SINCE we lost them. or a spring that is actually ours.

space_weather_at_pause.meaning: the magnetosphere is not washing tracks. if we cannot smell them, it is because they are not here — not because a storm erased them.
